tasks.short: Support student recruitment, registration and placement

steps.what: Discuss biology study options during student recruitment activities
Resolve academic questions raised during student registration
Discuss suitable student placements and academic fit

tasks.design: Keep the teacher's recruitment conversations and academic registration or placement advice personal. The {OTHER} student records system supplies existing information; no automated eligibility or placement decision is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The teacher contributes subject expertise rather than merely moving registration data.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing records support that advice without changing the decision-maker.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding a student's goals and suitability for a placement.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher can explain realistic study and placement choices.
tasks.altitude: The teacher retains academic advisory responsibility.

reach.learn: Translate biology learning goals into placement expectations

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: academic recruitment and placement advice depend on subject expertise and individual circumstances.

assumptions: Boundary is teacher participation; registrar data entry, admissions decisions and employer selection are outside it and unchanged.

Existing registration officer produces the student record and programme owner produces current rules before s2. Teacher reads and checks them within its 30 hours; missing records cause manual enquiry, not an inferred eligibility flag.
Check native records configuration before adding software; existing runtime earns no saving.
Zero upkeep because no new tool or changed process is introduced.
research_questions: Does observation reveal any separate duplicate entry performed by the teacher?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross and net=0. No advisory or placement decision work is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Decide departmental administrative priorities and resolve escalations
Coordinate administrative follow-through with department staff

tasks.design: Keep departmental decisions and coordination with the head. Inspect actual work in {EMAIL} before claiming a repeatable document or transfer task; the broad duty alone does not establish one.
tasks.previous_blocker: Administrative responsibilities vary greatly with delegated staff support.
tasks.enabler_now: No new technology establishes which part of this role is repetitive.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting staff needs and limited departmental resources.
tasks.human_edge: The head resolves trade-offs and secures practical agreement.
tasks.altitude: Departmental authority and coordination remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Distinguish delegated execution from academic decisions

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: department-head work mixes judgement and coordination; a generic administrative label does not quantify automatable clerical time.

assumptions: Boundary is head-level decisions and coordination; specialised teaching, research and registrar tasks are separately owned.
Head produces department decisions in s1 before s2. No automatically produced priority or agreed-action code is assumed; coordination and capture are counted in s2's 40 hours.
Test existing administrative tools before custom code; current runtime earns no saving.
Zero upkeep because no changed process is proposed.
unknowns: Share of actual repeated clerical work
research_questions: Which recurring administrative artefact is still manually recreated by the head?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross and net=0. No clerical baseline is invented for a broad leadership duty.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define the subject and level of the outside reading assignment
Find and select specialised materials with verified catalogue records
Format the bibliography from selected records in the reference manager
Check bibliography accuracy and release the reading list

tasks.design: Configure a {OTHER} reference manager to format only records the teacher has selected and verified. The teacher checks that every item resolves to the intended edition and suits the assignment before publication in {LMS}; no generated titles enter the list.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selected references may be repeatedly typed and reformatted by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reference-manager exports apply a chosen citation style consistently.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing scientifically sound, accessible material at the right level.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher judges relevance, difficulty and the balance of the reading list.
tasks.altitude: Less citation formatting while retaining selection and release authority.

reach.task: Resolve a missing or wrong reference record
reach.learn: Check identifiers, editions and student access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: reference managers can format verified bibliographic metadata without generating article titles or judging educational suitability.
The Leiden memo reports that fabricated references can pass plagiarism checks; resolving references is a separate check.

assumptions: Boundary is compiling a bibliography, not teaching, student reading or a research review.

Catalogue or publisher produces title, authors, year, publication, edition and DOI or catalogue identifier. Teacher verifies and imports selected fields plus citation style in s2's 45 hours before s3; missing fields are entered manually there or the item is withheld. S4 checks links and intended editions; no automatic validity flag is assumed.
Test the native reference manager before code; saving requires actual manual formatting rather than existing runtime.
Four focal upkeep hours cover metadata corrections, export failures and style changes.
unknowns: Metadata quality for specialist books and chapters
research_questions: Does a timed reading-list sample retain all intended references while reducing manual formatting?

already_counted.description: Scope, source selection and verified metadata capture

approvals.approved_version: Exact reading-list version, reference identities, editions, links and assignment scope checked in s4; any change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=80, gross=20 and net=16 after four upkeep hours. Range assumes a partly manual bibliography-formatting baseline; source selection and all educational judgement retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Participate in public campus and community events

steps.what: Prepare accurate biology content for a public presentation
Give the public presentation and participate in event discussions

tasks.design: Keep scientific preparation and live public engagement with the teacher. Existing materials in {DOCS} can be reused when appropriate, but no repeated formatting burden is established by the task statement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Public understanding depends on clear explanation and accurate answers.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing source materials support preparation without replacing the speaker.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining uncertainty and responding to unexpected questions.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher adapts the explanation to the audience in the room.
tasks.altitude: Public engagement remains a personal responsibility.

reach.learn: Adapt biology explanations to public questions

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: public scientific engagement requires accurate preparation and responsive live explanation.

assumptions: Boundary covers teacher preparation and participation; event logistics and audience time are outside it and unchanged.
Teacher produces checked presentation materials in s1 before delivery in s2; no automatically produced scientific-accuracy flag is used.
Use existing presentation and document tools before code; current runtime is not labour saved.
Zero upkeep because no new tool or changed process is proposed.
unknowns: Whether material preparation contains a repeated clerical component
research_questions: Which parts of preparation recur unchanged across events?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross and net=0. Live participation and scientific preparation are unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain academic and public-facing judgement while reducing any verified manual bibliography formatting.
reach: Resolve specialist reference records with library staff
role.ambitious_version: A biology teacher who publishes reliable reading lists and protects time for students, colleagues and public discussion.
